notes: Short summary: mid-market B2B SaaS that provides knowledge-enabled workflows for finance teams. Started on Hosted API to validate low-friction embedding + rerank flow; POC showed decent perf but want Dedicated for predictable throughput and isolation. Product emphasized low-latency chat for live support (goal: p95 < 100ms in NA; internal ask for 50ms p95 for high-tier). Procurement now driving move to Dedicated — primary asks: committed monthly GPU capacity, guaranteed burst behavior, and explicit SLA with credits. Legal returned heavy redlines on indemnity, export restrictions, and audit rights. Security team wants explicit KMS integration (bring-your-own-key) and EU data residency clause for EU customers. Engineering asked for example deployment topology (subnet/VPC peering), onboarding runbook, and timing estimate for migration from Hosted sandbox to Dedicated pool. AE notes: "POC looked good; infra team impressed with continuous batching numbers, but procurement is price-sensitive — needs ARR justification." Next steps: AE to produce a redline summary + draft compromise language on liability by 2026-03-16; SE to produce sample architecture diagram and onboarding timeline by 2026-03-18; Legal to schedule a call with Redwood counsel week of 2026-03-22. Key risk: if liability and residency terms not acceptable, customer will consider multi-vendor strategy (keep Hosted for non-sensitive workloads, move critical flows to on-prem later).
